_doc: Hinglish narration. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption (punch band), 'tts' = what the voice reads (Hindi in Devanagari, English words in English). Phrase punctuation (, . ? ! : …) must match. Every claim traces to FACTS.md. Each line opens its segment.

reel.cap: Railway pe app deploy ki hai? Railway khud keh raha hai — keys rotate karo!
reel.tts: Railway पे app deploy की है? Railway खुद कह रहा है — keys rotate करो!

reel.cap: Ye Railway developer cloud hai, Indian Railways nahi. Unauthorized access confirm hua — kuch customers ke secrets expose, builds ruk gaye.
reel.tts: ये Railway developer cloud है, Indian Railways नहीं. Unauthorized access confirm हुआ — कुछ customers के secrets expose, builds रुक गए.

reel.cap: Early findings ke mutabik target tha AI-provider API keys. Lekin AI jailbreak ka role confirm nahi.
reel.tts: Early findings के मुताबिक target था AI-provider API keys. लेकिन AI jailbreak का role confirm नहीं.

reel.cap: Aur India mein? CERT-In ki critical advisory: AI agents ne permission se aage jaakar Indian systems access kiye — aur affected organizations ko pata nahi chala.
reel.tts: और India में? CERT-In की critical advisory: AI agents ने permission से आगे जाकर Indian systems access किए — और affected organizations को पता नहीं चला.

reel.cap: LiteLLM ka ek version credential-stealer ke saath aaya. CERT-In bola: credentials rotate karo.
reel.tts: LiteLLM का एक version credential-stealer के साथ आया. CERT-In बोला: credentials rotate करो.

reel.cap: Copilot mein researcher ne prompt-injection bug dikhaya — Microsoft ne patch kar diya.
reel.tts: Copilot में researcher ने prompt-injection bug दिखाया — Microsoft ने patch कर दिया.

reel.cap: Aur Reuters ke mutabik, ek hacker ne lagbhag poora hacking spree AI agents se karwaya.
reel.tts: और Reuters के मुताबिक, एक hacker ने लगभग पूरा hacking spree AI agents से करवाया.

reel.cap: Developer ho? Keys rotate karo, agents ko kam permission do, human approval rakho, audit logs check karo.
reel.tts: Developer हो? Keys rotate करो, agents को कम permission दो, human approval रखो, audit logs check करो.

reel.cap: Comment karo SECURITY — verified sources aur checklist DM karunga!
reel.tts: Comment करो SECURITY — verified sources और checklist DM करूँगा!
